title: Implement V2 server migration and APIs
goal: Implement the approved V2 additive SQLite schema, safe migration and backup, all 34 API endpoints, human assignment conflicts, submissions and manual acceptance with full V1 regression coverage
acceptance_criteria: Create exactly the approved 12 tables and 10 indexes with schema version 2 and migration checksum
Implement all 34 frozen API endpoints and stable errors without changing V1 API CSV or JSON formats
Migration backup idempotent reopen rollback and V1 reset or delete history semantics are regression tested
All automated tests and Release governance validation pass

release_controls.rollback_plan: stop the service, preserve the failed database, atomically restore the validated pre-v2 SQLite backup, then revert the task commit
release_controls.observation_metrics: test results, migration backups, schema checks, API contract counts, V1 regressions, reviewer evidence
release_controls.stop_conditions: scope drift, migration checksum mismatch, backup failure, API contract drift, failing validation, or unresolved reviewer finding
